description: This Kotlin source file defines a Worker class 'WidgetUpdateWorker' responsible for periodically updating app widgets related to calendar and astrology within an Android application. It schedules periodic work using WorkManager, specifies constraints, and updates multiple widget types by invoking their respective update methods.

classes.name: WidgetUpdateWorker
classes.description: A worker class that updates calendar and astrology widgets periodically and handles scheduling of these updates.

methods.name: doWork
methods.description: Performs the widget update operations for calendar and astrology widgets, handles retries on exceptions.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Sets up and enqueues a periodic background task to update widgets every 30 minutes with specified constraints.
